en.title: Google launches Language Explorer to showcase global linguistic diversity
en.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research have launched **Language Explorer**, an interactive web platform designed to let people visualize global linguistic diversity. Developed under the 1,000 Languages Initiative, the tool is currently featured as an interactive installation at a major **museum exhibition** in Berlin and is also accessible online.
en.full_summary: Google has a long history of expanding language technologies, growing from supporting just two languages in Google Translate in 2006 to nearly 250 languages today. Building products that reflect the world's linguistic diversity requires grassroots initiatives like Project Vaani in India and Project Waxal in Africa, as well as partnerships with local communities and organizations like the Gates Foundation. The newly released **Language Explorer** builds upon the open-source LinguaMeta dataset, bringing together data across thousands of languages to help researchers, educators, and language enthusiasts understand global speech diversity. This tool serves as a centerpiece in the Real Talk! Language. Power. World. exhibition at the Museum of Communication in Berlin, running through February 2028, and will also be featured in Frankfurt through September 2029, highlighting Google's ongoing efforts to make AI and language technologies accessible to everyone.

zh.title: 谷歌推出语言探索工具展示全球丰富的语言多样性
zh.summary: 谷歌深度思维与谷歌研究院联合推出了**语言探索工具**，这是一个能让人直观感受全球语言多样性的在线互动平台。该工具作为千种语言计划的一部分，目前正在柏林的一家**博物馆展览**中作为互动装置展出，普通用户也可以直接在线访问。
zh.full_summary: 谷歌在语言技术领域深耕多年，翻译服务支持的语言数量从2006年的两种增加到如今的近250种。为了开发能够反映全球语言多样性的产品，谷歌在印度开展了瓦尼计划，在非洲开展了瓦克萨尔计划，并与盖茨基金会等当地社区和机构合作。新发布的**语言探索工具**基于开源的LinguaMeta数据集，汇集了数千种语言的数据，旨在帮助研究人员、教育工作者和语言爱好者理解全球语音的多样性。这款工具也是柏林通信博物馆真实对话展览中的核心展品之一，展期将持续到2028年2月，随后还将在法兰克福展出，这凸显了谷歌致力于让所有人都能使用人工智能和语言技术的持续努力。

en.title: langchain-core 1.7.7 - A bug-fix release for AI application development
en.summary: This is a routine update for langchain-core, the foundational library for building **AI applications**. It fixes a potential **nesting depth** issue and patches security vulnerabilities in dependencies. It ensures your AI workflows run more securely and stably.
en.full_summary:
## Detailed Features

The langchain-core 1.7.7 release focuses on stability and security enhancements rather than adding major new features. It includes critical fixes for the **load()** function to prevent excessive nesting.

## System Architecture & Security

As part of the broader LangChain ecosystem, this core package handles fundamental abstractions and serialization. The latest patch specifically addresses **security locks** for newer Python environments to keep your dependency tree safe and compliant.

zh.title: langchain-core 1.7.7 - 专注于修复漏洞的 AI 开发核心库更新
zh.summary: 这是开发 **AI应用** 的核心底层库的一次常规更新。它主要修复了对象加载时的 **嵌套深度** 限制问题，并升级了相关依赖来堵住安全漏洞。这能让你的 AI 工作流跑得更安全、更稳定。
zh.full_summary:
## 详细功能

这次更新主要聚焦于底层架构的 **稳定修复**，而不是推出花哨的新功能。它重点解决了对象在加载时的嵌套深度问题，防止潜在的性能溢出。

## 系统架构与安全

作为 LangChain 生态的基石，这个核心库负责处理最基础的数据抽象和序列化。最新的补丁针对更新的 Python 环境优化了 **安全锁定**，确保你的项目依赖更加健康可靠。

en.title: Quantum Bit 2026 AI Annual Awards Submission Deadline in One Week
en.summary: Quantum Bit's **2026 AI annual awards** submission is entering its final week, with the deadline set for **November 16**. The selection covers enterprises, products, and individuals, aiming to recognize real-world AI implementation and industry pioneers.
en.full_summary:
## Background
As artificial intelligence shifts from technological validation to large-scale implementation in 2026, the industry is increasingly focused on actual results rather than just model parameters. To record this transition, Quantum Bit is hosting its annual AI awards.

## Categories and Details
The awards are divided into three main tracks: enterprise, product, and individual. The enterprise category features leading companies and high-potential startups; the product category highlights outstanding products and solutions; and the individual category focuses on emerging entrepreneurial talents under 40 years old.

## Significance
Submissions will close on November 16, and the final results will be announced at the MEET2027 Intelligent Future Conference on December 9 in Beijing. This event serves as a yearly observation note to help industry decision-makers navigate the practical application of AI.

zh.title: 量子位2026人工智能年度榜单征集倒计时一周
zh.summary: 量子位 **2026人工智能年度榜单** 征集已进入最后一周，将于 **11月16日** 截止报名。本次评选涵盖企业、产品和人物三大维度，旨在寻找那些让AI在真实场景中创造价值的行业先锋。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与定位
随着人工智能在2026年从技术验证走向 **规模化落地**，行业不再只看重参数规模，而是关注AI能否在真实场景中交付结果。为此，量子位推出了年度人工智能榜单，记录这一年的技术演进与产业实践。

## 奖项设置与标准
本次评选分为企业、产品和人物三大方向。企业榜关注 **领航企业** 与潜力创业公司；产品榜聚焦杰出产品与解决方案；人物榜则面向优秀的创业新锐。评选标准涵盖商业模式、技术创新能力及市场认可度等多个维度的综合考量。

## 后续安排
报名通道将于 **11月16日** 正式关闭，评选结果最终定于12月9日在北京举行的 MEET2027 智能未来大会上正式公布，为行业决策者提供参考样本。

en.title: langchain-fireworks 1.7.3 - Fix default max_tokens and refresh model profiles
en.summary: This is a minor update for the **langchain-fireworks** integration package. It fixes an issue with the default **max_tokens** setting using model profiles and refreshes the underlying model data to keep everything up to date.
en.full_summary:
## Overview
This release introduces version 1.7.3 of the **langchain-fireworks** package, focusing primarily on bug fixes and data maintenance to ensure smooth AI model interactions.

## Key Updates
The update fixes a bug regarding the default **max_tokens** parameter by correctly pulling values from the defined model profiles. Additionally, it performs a routine refresh of the **model profiles** data to accommodate newly updated or adjusted AI models.

zh.title: langchain-fireworks 1.7.3：修复默认最大令牌数并刷新模型配置

zh.full_summary:
## 概述
本次更新带来了 **langchain-fireworks** 包的 1.7.3 版本，主要聚焦于修复错误和数据维护，以确保与 AI 模型的交互更加顺畅。
## 核心更新
该版本修复了一个关于默认 **max_tokens** 参数的问题，能够正确从定义的模型配置文件中提取数值。此外，它还对 **模型配置数据** 进行了例行刷新，以适应最新更新或调整的 AI 模型。

en.title: 1.15.39 - Documentation update for error handling
en.summary: This is a minor release that **documents** the apps_not_connected error on kickoff and status endpoints, helping developers troubleshoot connection issues more easily.
en.full_summary:
## Documentation Updates

This update focuses entirely on improving the **developer experience** by clarifying error messages. It specifically documents the apps_not_connected error on the /kickoff and /status endpoints, ensuring users know how to respond when integrations are missing.

zh.title: 1.15.39 - 错误处理文档更新
zh.summary: 这是一个小版本更新，主要为 kickoff 和 status 接口**补充文档**，说明了未连接应用的错误提示，帮助开发者更轻松地排查连接问题。
zh.full_summary:
## 文档更新说明

本次更新完全聚焦于改善**开发者体验**，通过明确错误信息来提供帮助。它具体记录了 /kickoff 和 /status 接口上的 apps_not_connected 错误，确保用户在缺少集成时知道如何应对。
